title: CoNav-UAV: Cooperative Dual-Altitude Aerial Navigation via Stackelberg Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.01802v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Aerial search missions often require an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) to locate a target from only a brief description of its appearance and surroundings, a task known as target-oriented aerial vision-and-language navigation (VLN). The task demands city-scale exploration and grounding as well as collision-free close-range approach, two interleaved processes that are difficult to reconcile within a single agent. Most existing methods adapt the ground VLN paradigm to a single UAV and rely on external assistance to compensate for its inefficiency. A recent attempt deploys two UAVs at complementary altitudes but still depends on privileged sensing and trains the two agents independently, precluding any mutual adaptation. translated_title: CoNav-UAV：基于Stackelberg学习的协同双高度空中导航
translated_abstract: 空中搜索任务通常要求无人机（UAV）仅凭一段对目标外观及其周围环境的简短描述来定位目标，这一任务被称为面向目标的空中视觉与语言导航（VLN）。该任务既需要城市尺度的大范围探索与目标定位（grounding），又需要无碰撞的近距离接近，这两个相互交织的过程很难在单个智能体中协调统一。大多数现有方法将地面VLN范式套用到单个无人机上，并依赖外部辅助来弥补其效率不足。最近的一种尝试是在互补高度部署两架无人机，但仍然依赖特权感知，并且独立训练两个智能体，因而无法实现相互适应。我们提出了CoNav-UAV，将该任务建模为高空领导者与低空跟随者之间的Stackelberg博弈，以捕捉二者的序贯决策以及非对称的观测与效用……
tldr: 该论文提出CoNav-UAV，首次将面向目标的空中视觉语言导航建模为高空领导者与低空跟随者无人机之间的Stackelberg博弈，实现双高度协同导航与智能体间的相互适应。
en_tdlr: CoNav-UAV formulates target-oriented aerial VLN as a Stackelberg game between a high-altitude leader and a low-altitude follower UAV, enabling cooperative dual-altitude navigation with mutual adaptation between agents.
